svg.title: Agent refresh policy
svg.desc: Agent refresh policy flowchart: the agent service starts, initiates a refresh policy, downloads meta.xml and compares its version with the registry. If the version matches it checks whether the machine was removed from the server, then applies each server setting in turn and ends the refresh policy. If the version differs it verifies the installer checksum and either installs the new agent or skips the upgrade. Separately the agent checks its slot time in the registry and either waits ninety minutes or schedules the next refresh policy at the interval the server returned.
